subject: genetics
question: **Type:** calculation In somatic cells, all but one X chromosome is inactivated, and each inactivated X appears as a Barr body. How many Barr bodies are present in each somatic cell of a 47,XXY individual with Klinefelter syndrome?
explanation: The number of Barr bodies equals the number of X chromosomes minus one, because one X must remain active in every cell. A 47,XXY cell has two X chromosomes, so 2 - 1 = 1 Barr body. A (0) applies the normal male rule of no inactivation to an XXY cell, B (2) counts one Barr body per X without leaving one active, and D (3) adds the Y chromosome into the count.
